The pandemic exacerbated the terrible addiction and overdose crisis in Virginia‘s communities.

My bipartisan Summer Barrow Prevention, Treatment, & Recovery Act would take real steps to combat this trend, provide hope to our neighbors, and save lives.

https://t.co/pJA4tHMWm1

This year, I was proud to deliver nearly $2 million to help expand the Motts Run water treatment plant. 

With this funding signed into law, we are making sure the facility can maintain clean drinking water & keep up with demand as the region grows. #VA07 
https://t.co/T1H1pZrDyv

Feeding our kids is not a partisan issue.

I'm proud to lead a bipartisan effort to extend waivers and prevent children across #VA07 & the country from losing access to reliable meals.

These waivers provide important flexibilities to our schools.

https://t.co/WcrRDKc18g

🚨🚨🚨

In less than a month, child nutrition waivers are set to expire.

These waivers have helped feed thousands of Virginia students.

Congress must act now on my bipartisan bill to give @USDA authority to extend waivers and feed students through 2022-23 school year.

.#OTD in 1965 the Voting Rights Act was signed. This landmark law marked a turning point in our nation's history.

Yet today, the right to vote is under siege by far-right extremists.

I am committed to ensuring all Americans can exercise their right to vote.

Thank you to Jay at @NewsRadioWINA for the conversation about my recent bipartisan bills signed into law — including our Summer Barrow Prevention, Treatment, and Recovery Act.

This law will prevent overdoses and combat addiction here in Virginia.

https://t.co/d2uViPAE39

Virginian Summer Barrow died of a fentanyl overdose in 2020. 

Last month, @POTUS signed into law my bipartisan bill — the Summer Barrow Prevention, Treatment, and Recovery Act — to combat addiction and prevent future tragedies in our communities. 

https://t.co/gDpKnJ2fXB

To stop fentanyl overdoses, Democrats and Republicans need to work together to secure our borders AND boost support for treatment & recovery programs. 

Last month, @POTUS signed into law my bipartisan bill to strengthen fentanyl detection, as well as my bill to combat addiction.

In December, @POTUS signed my bipartisan bill into law to help border personnel intercept illicit fentanyl — as well as my bill to increase support for prevention, treatment, and recovery programs. 

We can do both. We need an all-out strategy to destroy the threat of fentanyl.

Overdoses are the leading cause of unnatural death in Virginia. 

That’s why I’m focused on cracking down on traffickers, supporting treatment and recovery programs, and stopping the scourge of fentanyl from killing more Virginians.

https://t.co/atXWtRERt6

Fentanyl has destroyed far too many lives in Virginia and across the country. 

That’s why I’m working in our communities — with law enforcement, healthcare providers, and treatment and recovery professionals — to find new ways to save lives. 

https://t.co/EezA4iU5mB https://t.co/BfoORDKmOG

As the only Virginian on the U.S. House Agriculture Committee, I’m focused on protecting — not slashing — nutrition programs that keep thousands of Virginia kids and families fed, including SNAP. 

https://t.co/HkMRCJjtAg

Ending the fentanyl crisis will take ALL of us — law enforcement, mental health providers, and every one of our neighbors — working together.

We’re working to secure Virginia’s streets, support treatment & recovery programs, and prevent overdoses.  

https://t.co/LWk38ePm5K

Virginia! Today is the first day of early voting in the Virginia 2024 primaries.

I encourage everyone to exercise your right to vote and make your voice heard.

You can find more information about your polling place at https://t.co/LaN1AtZ2EM👇

Happy Voting! 🇺🇸🗳️

🚨Polls are now open in Virginia!

I encourage all Virginia voters to exercise their right to vote. 

This right was earned, not given, through generations of struggle — and American heroes fought and died to defend it.

Go to https://t.co/Gt5tW1pNq3 to make a plan to vote.

We have a maternal health crisis that impacts so many women right here in Virginia. In Congress, I worked to tackle this issue at the federal level. As Governor, I'll make sure we act here in Virginia too. #MaternalHealthAwarenessDay
What a wonderful celebration of Chinese New Year in Falls Church today! To everyone celebrating: may your New Year bring good health and great fortune. https://t.co/ngRXwGzdaE

President Trump’s games have real consequences for Virginians. Because he threatened a funding freeze, several community health centers have now lost access to federal grant dollars. Patients arriving for appointments are being met with “closed” signs. That's unacceptable.

The Trump Administration just pulled millions in promised investments to protect clean drinking water in Portsmouth, Virginia.

They’re playing politics with Virginians’ health — and it’s disgraceful.

I'm sending my well wishes for a speedy recovery and good health to @PatHerrityVA.

Regardless of party, I can only imagine how difficult of a decision this was for Supervisor Herrity and his family.

Happy Earth Day, Virginia!

Let’s recommit to protecting Virginia's natural beauty — for our health, economy, and future generations to come.

As Governor, I’ll fight for clean air, safe water, and good-paying, clean energy jobs across the Commonwealth.

Anyone who has ever met Rep. Connolly knows what an extraordinary person he is. I'm proud to call him a friend. I know he will demonstrate conviction and fight every day that he continues to serve and stand up for Virginians. And I am praying for him, his family, and his health.

I ran for Congress to protect Virginians’ healthcare. Now, Trump and Republicans are threatening coverage for nearly 2M Virginians — including 700,000 kids.

As Governor, I’ll work to protect Medicaid and stand up to anyone trying to take healthcare away from our families.

Access to contraception and birth control is fundamental to women’s health and safety.

As the next Governor of Virginia, I’ll focus on lowering healthcare costs, defending access to affordable coverage, and protecting women’s access to reproductive healthcare. #WomensHealthWeek

My heart is with President Biden and his family at this time, and I wish President Biden great strength as he undergoes treatment.

Adam and I are praying for him and his family.
